abilities.name: Ironclad Onslaught
abilities.effect: Place a **defiled token** next to the target objective. Then, roll a D3 for each enemy unit contesting an objective that has a friendly **defiled token**. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.declare: Pick an objective that is contested by any friendly units to be the target.
